term_boundary_decisions.decision: The Foundation02 form submission is compatible with consideration, but the expression remains pending with held verify and unintegrated correct. Care-system submission is unscored; submit-button is a separate noun.

Foundation02.03 has ordinary request decisions. Most other hits are approved modifiers or passive statuses whose authorization/suitability distinction is unresolved. Rights clearance remains specialist and unapproved.
The only surface use is the ordinary request decision in Foundation02.03. Its pending expression gate remains. Reject-rate and employment/medical meanings receive no acceptance.
All nine surface uses belong to other nouns, compounds or sign-in. Clinical signs, sign-off, electronic-signature rules and signature stamps remain distinct.
Foundation02.02 remains held for the confirm/notify context. The transport expression uses a separately identified causative delay verb; production and delivery compounds remain separate.

Foundation02.04 remains pending with held verify. Error budget, clinical errors, cutoff/payroll errors and system codes retain separate identities and domain gates. Oxford describes error as more formal than mistake.
Foundation02.06 names a reported defect and an authorized team; it remains pending. Diagnostic, repair and machine-safety contexts and fault compounds receive no specialist acceptance.

Physical-harm uses and damage-report/surface-damage compounds stay unscored for this ID. Legal plural damages is a separate noun, not this noun pluralized; damaged and damaging are not accepted automatically.

Material and stock shortage compounds remain separately scored. Cash shortage is a discrepancy between counted and recorded cash and must not inherit the needed-supply definition. Short message is unrelated.
Object and reference absences fit the ordinary adjective but remain unscored. Missing-value/invoice identities, missing-person status and miss/missed/near-miss constructions remain separate.

complete_form_image_mismatch.action: Preserve live mismatched form-image brief, pending and unapproved. Finishing-sense language acceptance does not make the picture ready.

limits: Acceptance applies only to each exact definition, example and editorial difficulty projection bound below. It does not accept the entire entry or change a production flag.
No human, specialist, professional-procedure, expression, morphology, media, module, readiness or release approval transfers.
No new focus binding, reference registration, source-registry record, editorial note or review-gate change is made.
The four earlier lexical holds, all 17 inherited expression holds and the additional Foundation02.04/.05/.07/.08 preservation remain exact.
Third10 proposals remain unintegrated. Complete retains its live mismatched form-image brief, pending and unapproved.
Difficulty is an editorial placement for a bounded meaning, not source consensus or lesson certification. B1+ and cefr/fkcefr remain literal observations.
